sections.name: Pond
sections.note: The road by the buffalo pond, haystacks drying: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstBuffalo
sections.note: The first buffalo: jump onto its back and it bounces you high.

sections.name: SmallStacks
sections.note: Two small haystacks: hop, hop.

sections.name: BigStack
sections.note: A big haystack: a double jump onto it (the mangoes show it). A feather above it.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: Chain
sections.note: A haystack chain: small, big, small, big.

sections.name: Canal
sections.note: A 1.2 m canal.

sections.name: BuffaloFeather
sections.note: A buffalo, a feather above its bounce for a double jump at the top.

sections.name: DungStack
sections.note: Dung, then a small haystack.

sections.name: WideCanal
sections.note: The wide canal: double jump, or wade.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: BuffaloStacks
sections.note: A buffalo, then a small and a big haystack.

sections.name: Branch
sections.note: A mango tree, a haystack as the step up to its branch.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; the rooster knocks the hens' basket by the farmer's hut into the road; a canal after.

sections.name: TwoBuffaloes
sections.note: Two buffaloes: bounce, land, bounce.

sections.name: BigChain
sections.note: Big, small, big: a feather above the last.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: SacksCanal
sections.note: The harvest's sacks of paddy waiting for the cart: onto them, then a canal.

sections.name: BuffaloWide
sections.note: A buffalo, then the wide canal.

sections.name: StacksDung
sections.note: Small, dung, big.

sections.name: PlankGoat
sections.note: The plank over a 1.8 m canal, then a goat kid wandering across.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: A buffalo, a small and a big stack, a canal, ducks: everything once more.

sections.name: LastBuffalo
sections.note: Dung, and the last buffalo to bounce off.

sections.name: OpenFields
sections.note: The fields open out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 295 m.
